newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa tumbles, coffee steadier, sugar off.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa tumbles, coffee steadier, sugar off.

text.p: COCOA - Still sharply lower in brisk trade after slipping through key 1,100 support. Sept ends midday 39 stg down at 1,070 after a low at 1,064.
COFFEE - Holds slight gains but below session's best. Volume extremely small. Sept up $10 at $1,850.
SUGAR - Resumes downtrend as players move out of August position. Spread eases. Aug off $1.80 at $317.20 at 1135 GMT.
